topic: Fold-seal catalog admission reserves the full worst-case shape using saturating
canonical_claim: Fold-seal catalog admission reserves the full worst-case shape using saturating arithmetic: the widest fixed frame, one widest rfl row per catalog entry, and one widest btr plus cnd row for each persisted gc_shards value

topic: v2 Proto bodies use one whole-body zstd frame when raw_len is at least the defau
canonical_claim: v2 Proto bodies use one whole-body zstd frame when raw_len is at least the default 4 KiB threshold, while readers accept compressed and uncompressed bodies unconditionally

topic: v2 caps Proto decode raw_len at 1 MiB for singletons, 64 MiB for CARS root shard
canonical_claim: v2 caps Proto decode raw_len at 1 MiB for singletons, 64 MiB for CARS root shards, and 256 MiB for CAPT, retired sets, outcome logs, and fold seals

topic: v2 stream objects have no body cap because resident memory is one block with a h
canonical_claim: v2 stream objects have no body cap because resident memory is one block with a hard cap of 1 MiB plus a bounded footer index

topic: v3 compression is whole-object single-frame zstd selected per type
canonical_claim: v3 compression is whole-object single-frame zstd selected per type: Always types use a .zst key suffix and all other types are raw without a suffix

topic: v3 line caps are 64 KiB for singleton and ref objects, 64 KiB descriptor lines f
canonical_claim: v3 line caps are 64 KiB for singleton and ref objects, 64 KiB descriptor lines for cas_part_manifest, 4 KiB for cas_run records, and exactly 256 bytes for the cas_blob header

topic: Embedding every visited namespace in every fold seal is not bounded because fold
canonical_claim: Embedding every visited namespace in every fold seal is not bounded because fold seals have a 256 MiB control-object limit and namespace churn is unbounded

topic: The `disk_transaction_wait_for_blob_removal` server setting defaults to `1` and
canonical_claim: The `disk_transaction_wait_for_blob_removal` server setting defaults to `1` and makes the server wait for background blob removal to complete before acknowledging the operation.

topic: Per-query jemalloc profiling uses `jemalloc_enable_profiler = 1`
canonical_claim: Per-query jemalloc profiling uses `jemalloc_enable_profiler = 1`; `jemalloc_collect_profile_samples_in_trace_log = 1` additionally records per-query `JemallocSample` rows in `system.trace_log`.

topic: The proposed root-shard journal controls are `max_unprocedded_journal_records_to
canonical_claim: The proposed root-shard journal controls are `max_unprocedded_journal_records_to_throw` for a hard write-failing limit and `max_unprocedded_journal_records_to_delay` for delaying writes when the journal is long.

topic: `gc_round_manifest_cleanup_budget` defaults to 5000 manifest deletions per GC ro
canonical_claim: `gc_round_manifest_cleanup_budget` defaults to 5000 manifest deletions per GC round, and the value `0` means unbounded cleanup.; `gc_round_manifest_cleanup_budget` defaults to `5000` and limits the `manifest_deletes` phase; exhaustion records `skipped_budget` and leaves the undeleted manifests for a later reclaimer.

topic: The manifest orphan sweep lists at most 1000 keys and deletes at most 100 keys p
canonical_claim: The manifest orphan sweep lists at most 1000 keys and deletes at most 100 keys per round, so it cannot promptly drain a large budget-induced manifest-deletion debt.

topic: `scratch_path` is a server-local filesystem directory for staging write-buffer d
canonical_claim: `scratch_path` is a server-local filesystem directory for staging write-buffer data, defaults to `<clickhouse-path>/disks/<disk_name>/cas_scratch/`, and a relative override is anchored to the server data path.

topic: `gc_meta_pool_size` defaults to 16 and bounds the thread pool used for GC freshn
canonical_claim: `gc_meta_pool_size` defaults to 16 and bounds the thread pool used for GC freshness-metadata writes during condemn, spare, and delete operations.

topic: `publishCkpt` has `MAX_CKPT_CAS_ATTEMPTS = 100` attempt-bounded retries
canonical_claim: `publishCkpt` has `MAX_CKPT_CAS_ATTEMPTS = 100` attempt-bounded retries.

topic: `content_addressed_gc_grace_sec` is rejected as an unknown setting and there is
canonical_claim: `content_addressed_gc_grace_sec` is rejected as an unknown setting and there is no core retire-grace throttle associated with it.

topic: `gc_round_graduation_budget` and `gc_round_redelete_budget` are `UInt64` setting
canonical_claim: `gc_round_graduation_budget` and `gc_round_redelete_budget` are `UInt64` settings with default `5000`; `0` means unbounded, and matching fields are carried through `PoolConfig`.

topic: `gc_round_sweep_namespace_budget` defaults to `20` and `gc_round_sweep_recovery_
canonical_claim: `gc_round_sweep_namespace_budget` defaults to `20` and `gc_round_sweep_recovery_op_budget` defaults to `5000`; both use `0` for unbounded work.

topic: `gc_round_ref_cleanup_budget` defaults to `5000` and `gc_round_prefix_wholesale_
canonical_claim: `gc_round_ref_cleanup_budget` defaults to `5000` and `gc_round_prefix_wholesale_budget` defaults to `20000`; `0` means unbounded for both settings.

topic: `gc_round_outcome_entry_budget` defaults to `5000` and caps the cumulative numbe
canonical_claim: `gc_round_outcome_entry_budget` defaults to `5000` and caps the cumulative number of `OutcomeEntry` rows appended across redelete and spared loops in one round; `0` is unbounded.

topic: `gc_round_handoff_prefix_wholesale_budget` defaults to `5000` and is stored sepa
canonical_claim: `gc_round_handoff_prefix_wholesale_budget` defaults to `5000` and is stored separately from the prune-only `gc_round_prefix_wholesale_budget`; its budget is consumed by the post-CAS hand-off reclaim.

topic: The content-addressed disk configuration surface rejects unknown keys (with an e
canonical_claim: The content-addressed disk configuration surface rejects unknown keys (with an explicit skip-list for generic object-storage-layer keys) and includes: `scratch_path` (default: server data path), `blob_hash` (default `cityhash128`, options `cityhash128`/`xxh3-128`/`sha256`, fixed at pool creation), `blob_hash_allow_new` (default `false`), `staging_backend` (default `local`; `s3` is opt-in and gated on the conditional-copy probe), `gc_meta_pool_size` (default 16), `manifest_sweep_list_budget_keys`/`manifest_sweep_delete_budget_keys` (default 1000/100), `dedup_cache_bytes` (default 64 MiB, 0 disables), `part_folder_cache_bytes`/`_max_entries`/`_max_entry_bytes` (default 64 MiB / 10000 / 16 MiB), `part_folder_validate` (default `always`; options `always`/`never`/`age <seconds>`), `gcs_max_conditional_put_bytes` (default 1 GiB), and `skip_access_check` (default `false`, skips the boot capability probe).

topic: The delete ThreadPool sizing (gc_delete_pool_size) for the meta-descriptor raw-b
canonical_claim: The delete ThreadPool sizing (gc_delete_pool_size) for the meta-descriptor raw-body redesign starts at a default of 16 and is left to be validated/tuned by the soak task (Task 7 step 4), not fixed at design time.

topic: No CA code capped `s3_max_connections` to backend permits, leaving a risk of 503
canonical_claim: No CA code capped `s3_max_connections` to backend permits, leaving a risk of 503 and retry storms under high concurrency.

topic: Every technical claim in the consolidated documentation must be traceable to an
canonical_claim: Every technical claim in the consolidated documentation must be traceable to an old document or the code, and each target document must label relevant sections `DONE`, `TODO`, `REJECTED`, or `DESIRABLE`.

topic: The consolidation keeps all `docs/superpowers/models/*
canonical_claim: The consolidation keeps all `docs/superpowers/models/*.tla` and `*.cfg` sources untouched and also keeps the active D1 spec, plan, and model; their prose results and readmes may be consolidated separately.

topic: The consolidation is explicitly synthesis rather than concatenation
canonical_claim: The consolidation is explicitly synthesis rather than concatenation: new documents should remain manageable, and claims must not be invented.

topic: New pages under `docs/en/` require frontmatter fields `description`, `sidebar_la
canonical_claim: New pages under `docs/en/` require frontmatter fields `description`, `sidebar_label`, `sidebar_position`, `slug`, `title`, and `doc_type`, and every heading requires an explicit kebab-case anchor.

topic: CAS is described as experimental because the code is actively cleaned up and bac
canonical_claim: CAS is described as experimental because the code is actively cleaned up and backward-incompatible format changes remain possible, while the implementation is intended to work correctly today.

topic: The obscure-name cleanup changes CamelCase `Gc` to `GC`, `Ckpt` to `Checkpoint`,
canonical_claim: The obscure-name cleanup changes CamelCase `Gc` to `GC`, `Ckpt` to `Checkpoint`, `Txns` to `Transactions`, and `Dedup` to `Deduplication` in user-facing CAS names.
